description: This Java source file defines a command handler class for bulk repayment operations in the GLIM (Grouped Loan in Microfinance) context within the Fineract project. The class implements the necessary interface to handle commands, specifically for the 'REPAYMENT' action on 'GLIMLOAN' entities, and delegates the repayment logic to the LoanWritePlatformService.

classes.name: GLIMBulkRepaymentCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class for processing bulk GLIM loan repayment commands, annotated as a service and marked with specific command type metadata.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command processing by invoking the loan write platform service to perform the GLIM loan repayment logic.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to perform a GLIM loan repayment, annotated with @Transactional to ensure database transaction management.
